concerns.text: FR-003 mandates executing static analysis on ALL generated and human samples. T013 is marked [ ] (unverified/missing) and describes the implementation but lacks the required output artifact `data/processed/raw_vulnerability_reports.json` in the current state, leaving the FR unfulfilled.

FR-012 requires calculating group-specific False Positive Rates (FPR) and applying an adjustment formula. T023 is marked [ ] (unverified/missing), meaning the required output `data/processed/fpr_metrics.json` is absent, breaking the data dependency for T020.

FR-008 and Constitution Principle IV require generating `results/summary.md` tracing back to `data/processed`. T032 and T033 are marked [ ] (unverified/missing), leaving the reporting requirement unfulfilled.

SC-005 requires measuring reproducibility by re-running the pipeline and verifying floating-point outputs differ by ≤1e-6. T037 is marked [ ] (unverified/missing), with no evidence of logs or diff artifacts produced to satisfy this success criterion.
T038 requires running the `pytest` suite and verifying all tests pass. It is marked [ ] (unverified/missing), with no test execution logs or result files present to prove the suite ran successfully.
T039 requires verifying no PII leakage in logs or reports. It is marked [ ] (unverified/missing), with no security scan logs or manual review artifacts provided to substantiate the claim.

T001 requires creating the project structure (`code/`, `data/`, `results/`, `state/`, `tests/`). It is marked [ ] (unverified/missing), with no directory listing or file tree evidence provided to confirm the structure exists.

T020 implements logic to apply FPR adjustment to the primary ZINB model input. However, Plan.md (Phase 3.2) and Spec (FR-004) explicitly state the primary test uses RAW counts, with FPR adjustments for sensitivity analysis only. This task description contradicts the specification's definition of the primary metric.
